_meta_itemized.wave: itemized-vision(claude-opus-5; 2026-08-14 summit scan tranche, Phase B)

contributions.detail: DELTA of $5,030.61, and it is NOT a transcription shortfall - it is a contradiction INSIDE the document. The rows close the schedule's own arithmetic to the cent: the three >$50 rows sum to $400.00, which is exactly the '>$50' box printed at the top of p2, and Mike Gannon's $20.00 is exactly the '<=$50' box. What does not close is SHEET against COVER - the cover's '>$50' cell reads $5,430.61 where p2's own box reads $400.00. So $5,030.61 of the contributions this candidate reported are UNITEMIZED on a form whose printed instruction is 'These reports must include a list of all donations over $50 including the name of the donor'. The shape of the cover says what it almost certainly is: contributions ($5,450.61) exactly equal expenditures ($5,450.61) and the campaign balance is $0.00 - the signature of a self-funded campaign in which the candidate's own money was entered on the cover and never written onto the schedule. That is an INFERENCE ABOUT THE FILER, not a row: no row was created for it, no donor was named, and nothing was imputed. Anyone using this filing must know that the itemized layer accounts for 7.7% of the stated contributions. Specimen row 'Jon and Jane Doe / PO Box 128, Coalville, UT 84017 / $435.00', dated 8/25/10, dropped - the boxes close only without it.

expenditures.detail: exact to the cent - 15 rows sum to 5,450.61 = the schedule's printed box = the cover's Current and Cumulative expenditure cells. This is the strongest verification available and no cell needed escalation. Specimen row 'Name of Business / Campaign signs and flyers / $512.00', dated 8/25/10 on this copy, dropped: including it would give 5,962.61 and nothing would close. One row carries no date - the cell prints the word 'Various' - and is stored blank with needs_review=1 rather than dated from the report.

_meta_itemized.page_gates: Three pages: p1 cover (already transcribed), p2 ITEMIZED CONTRIBUTION REPORT, p3 ITEMIZED EXPENSE REPORT. Both ledgers are TYPED, not handwritten, and are the cleanest sheets in this chunk - but the county's scan still carries a garbled OCR layer (`draft.py` returns '$43s.00', '8l25lt0', '$2s.03'), so every figure here was read from the 200 dpi page image, not from the text layer. EXPENSE GATE: p3 prints 'Total amount of expenditures $5,450.61'; its 15 rows sum to 5,450.61 to the cent, equal to the cover's Current and Cumulative expenditure cells. CONTRIBUTION GATE - AND THE FINDING ON THIS FILING: p2 prints its own two boxes, '>$50 $400.00' and '<=$50 $20.00', and the four rows reproduce BOTH exactly (200 + 100 + 100 = 400; Gannon's 20 = 20). The schedule is therefore internally perfect. The COVER, however, states $5,430.61 in the '>$50' row - the same cell the schedule says is $400.00. p1 was re-rendered and re-read at 130 dpi purely to confirm this is on the page and not a cache artefact: it is, in both the Current Report and Cumulative Totals columns. The document contradicts itself by $5,030.61 and neither figure was altered. Specimen rows dropped from both pages; note this copy dates BOTH specimens 8/25/10 - the 2010-dated variant of the blank form.

_meta_itemized.notes: Vicki Sue Richards, County Recorder/Surveyor, 2014 Pre-Election, signed 10/27/2014, county RECEIVED stamp Oct 27 2014. split50 form, TYPED ledgers on a scanned sheet. SOURCE PROPERTIES WORTH RECORDING: (1) THE SCHEDULE AND THE COVER STATE DIFFERENT CONTRIBUTION TOTALS. This is not the familiar split50 structural residual (where the ledger reproduces the >$50 box and the residual is the <=$50 aggregate). Here BOTH boxes on the schedule are reproduced exactly and the disagreement is between the schedule's >$50 box ($400.00) and the cover's >$50 cell ($5,430.61). A wave that gates only 'rows vs the schedule's printed total' would pass this filing as clean; only the second gate - rows against the figure the MODULE publishes from the cover - catches it. Both gates are needed, and this filing is the case that proves it. (2) TWO NAME CELLS ARE CLIPPED BY THE FORM'S COLUMN WIDTH ('Summit County Republic' twice on p2, 'Rachel Charles Photograph' on p3). The typed string is longer than the cell and the overflow is simply not printed - it does not exist anywhere on the page or in the OCR layer. The visible text is stored verbatim and the obvious completions are NOT supplied. (3) A DONOR IS NAMED AS AN EVENT: 'Republican Fundraiser', $100.00. Kept verbatim; it is what the form says. Two of the four contribution rows come from the county Republican party organisation and a third from a party fundraiser, so on the itemized evidence this campaign's outside money is entirely party money. (4) THE SPECIMEN ROWS ON THIS COPY ARE DATED 8/25/10, not 8/25/14 - the 2010-dated printing of the blank form, still in circulation in the 2014 cycle (the 1244 Brock copy carries the 8/25/14 variant, so both printings were in use that year). (5) ONE EXPENSE DATE IS THE WORD 'Various'. Blank + needs_review, verbatim in the row note. PRIVACY: p2 prints a Mailing Address and Zipcode column; the one street address on the page was discarded at read time. Only donor_city / donor_state are stored. Three of the four rows print no state token at all, so their donor_state is honestly blank - a state is never inferred from a zip. Nothing on this filing is redacted. GEOMETRY: the two pages are treated differently, on the evidence of what each page's rules support. p3's printed grid detects cleanly - 19 bands and a full set of five vertical rules (7.78% to 89.88%, so the box spans date through amount) - so its 15 rows carry MEASURED geometry, bands 3 to 17, verified by crop at band 3 (CustomInk / Stickers / $355.00) and band 17 (Various / Wal-Mart / $200.00). p2's detection is CONTAMINATED rather than absent: 52 'bands' at heights of 0.5-1.0% because the page's own typed text lines register as rules, and only ONE vertical rule found. Its four rows therefore use a DECLARED frame (force_declared, x=8.0 y0=24.028 pitch=1.953 w=82.0) fitted to the rules measured in a narrow x-slice of the RAW page - a clean uniform ladder at 22.039 (header), 24.028 (specimen), 25.972, 27.916, 29.860, 31.826 - and validated by crop at band 2 (Summit County Republic / $200.00) and band 5 (Mike Gannon / $20.00).
